newsitem.title: USA: Rubin reiterates belief in a strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Rubin reiterates belief in a strong dollar.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Friday repeated his assertion that a strong dollar is in the U.S. interest and will remain so.
Questioned by reporters following remarks to the Conference of Mayors group, Rubin said: "I think a strong dollar has contributed to lower interest rates and lower inflation."
"I think a strong dollar is very much in our interest and will remain so," he said.

Rubin also told reporters he believed the outlook for inflation remained good. "I must say one always has to be watchful of inflation but as I look around this country, and around the world, I think the most likely scenario is low inflation."
